reviews.comment: Very thick accent makes lectures somewhat useless. Homework in this class is unnecessarily tedious especially since much of the learning will be done on your own. Be prepared for lots of visits to TA's in order to succeed in her class.

Avoid at all costs. Her lectures are incomprehensible because of her thick Portuguese accent, and illegible handwriting, and her slides don't explain concepts well at all. Bring other work to her lectures to get done, and be ready to teach yourself everything during the homework assignments.

Many people don't like the language barrier she has, but that isn't that big of a problem since it is computer science. What is a problem instead of giving generalized tips, she goes through a specific problem that only has to do with that example. She took power points from other professors and somehow glanced over the general parts of it.

Awful. Had mandatory attendance, but students started to skip after a month. Her accent is barely understandable, and in combination of her awful handwriting, you won't be able to understand what's going in class. Use this class time to do anything else outside of focusing on what she's saying. Homework in this class are extremely time-consuming.

Language Barrier made it very difficult to understand and follow along. Mandated attendance but always forgot to check the attendance sheet. Examples and presentations in class were no where near the material that was assigned in the homework and didn't provide good exam preparation. Be prepared to self learn with this prof.

Of all 121 profs, she's best. The bad reviews come from students who don't want to own up to their own poor performance. Get over it. No one likes teaching or taking this course. Language barriers are not deal breakers, as programming is universal. Even if she were a bad prof (she isn't), it's no excuse to not learn.

A lot of students were reported to the honor council because she was unable to teach her class without a language barrier in the way. Hard to follow along in lecture. The examples in class and homework were super different. Examples were easy easy, homework was super tough. taught myself via Zybooks and youtube. Don't take her class. Waste of time

I learned NOTHING in her class. She is very nice, but that didn't nothing. On the first day, she said it was her first time speaking English for that amount of time. I believe her. Although it's not her fault, there is a language barrier that makes it very hard to learn. My TA's were also not useful, but I've heard different about others.

While she was a nice professor, her lectures were hard to follow. She started taking lecture attendance halfway through the semester, but I never really paid attention and just took notes from the slides in advance. Doing the ZyBooks activities and taking advantage of the TAs' office hours helped me the most.

It is clear how much Holanda cares for her students, however, care is not always enough. I understand the difficulty presented with teaching in a completely different language, but unfortunately, she is almost impossible to understand as her lectures are an incoherent mess. I learned from the textbook and resources of other profs exclusively. Avoid

This was her first time teaching this very daunting course, and she did a great job. She is fair to everyone, very responsive to emails, and always willing to help. Assignments are time-consuming busywork, but it's not her fault, the course is designed that way no matter which professor you take. Very caring and kind professor.

Dr.Holanda is a caring and understanding professor. She understands how hard the course. I will say her lecturers are hard to follow along to in person, so I watched her lecture recordings in 2x speed. They are good lectures, and she knows what she is talking about. I had 0 coding experience coming and only passed because I lived pt central.
